text:
The reporting mode filter defines the level of detail of the reporting.
Whether SEv should be dropped, forwarded with context data or
forwarded without context data. The parameter determines if the SEv
is either:
- dropped (OFF) - sent without context data (BRIEF) - sent with context
data (DETAILED) - sent without context data, ignoring the rest of the
filter chain (BRIEF_BYPASSING_FILTERS) - sent with context data
ignoring the rest of the filter chain (DETAILED_BYPASSING_FILTERS)
